title: Deer
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- antlers -->
  <g stroke='#c98a3a' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'>
    <path d='M38 34 L30 18 M30 18 L22 12 M30 18 L34 8'/>
    <path d='M62 34 L70 18 M70 18 L78 12 M70 18 L66 8'/>
  </g>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='40' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#d99a4e' transform='rotate(-25 28 40)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='40' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#d99a4e' transform='rotate(25 72 40)'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='22' ry='20' fill='#e0a95c'/>
  <!-- forehead patch lighter -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#f0c98a'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='13' ry='11' fill='#f5d9a8'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#4a2c14'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#4a2c14'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='46.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='4.5' ry='3.5' fill='#5a3018'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 61 L50 66 M50 66 Q45 69 42 66 M50 66 Q55 69 58 66' stroke='#a86a2e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
